SELECT clcp.pledge_times_from as pledge_times_from_n, clcp.pledge_times_to as pledge_times_to_n, CLCP.*, CON.CONTRACT_NAME PLEDGE_DOC_NAME, CON.APPROVAL_NUMBER PLEDGE_DOC_NUMBER, CON.DUE_AMOUNT, CON.SURPLUS_AMOUNT, CON.APPROVAL_NUMBER PLEDGE_DOC_NUMBER_N, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' and scv.value = CLCP.PLEDGE_RELEASE_FLAG) PLEDGE_RELEASE_FLAG_N FROM CT_LON_CONTRACT_PLEDGE CLCP JOIN ( SELECT CLCP.PLEDGE_ID, CONTRACT.CONTRACT_ID, CONTRACT.CONTRACT_NAME, CONTRACT.CONTRACT_NUMBER, CONTRACT.APPROVAL_NUMBER, nvl(SUM( CASE WHEN (CLCP.PLEDGE_TIMES_FROM <= CONTRACT.TIMES AND CLCP.PLEDGE_TIMES_TO >= CONTRACT.TIMES ) THEN CONTRACT.DUE_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END),0) DUE_AMOUNT, nvl(SUM( CASE WHEN (CLCP.PLEDGE_TIMES_FROM <= CONTRACT.TIMES AND CLCP.PLEDGE_TIMES_TO >= CONTRACT.TIMES ) THEN CONTRACT.DUE_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END),0) -nvl(SUM( CASE WHEN (CLCP.PLEDGE_TIMES_FROM <= CONTRACT.TIMES AND CLCP.PLEDGE_TIMES_TO >= CONTRACT.TIMES ) THEN CONTRACT.RECEIVED_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END),0) SURPLUS_AMOUNT FROM CT_LON_CONTRACT_PLEDGE CLCP LEFT JOIN ( ( SELECT CON.CONTRACT_ID, CON.CONTRACT_NAME, CON.CONTRACT_NUMBER, PP.APPROVAL_NUMBER, CON_FLOW.DUE_AMOUNT, CON_FLOW.RECEIVED_AMOUNT, CON_FLOW.TIMES, 'CON_CONTRACT' DOC_CATEGORY FROM CON_CONTRACT CON JOIN PRJ_PROJECT PP ON PP.PROJECT_ID=CON.PROJECT_ID JOIN CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CON_FLOW ON CON.CONTRACT_ID = CON_FLOW.CONTRACT_ID WHERE CON.DATA_CLASS = 'NORMAL' AND CON_FLOW.CF_STATUS = 'RELEASE' AND CON_FLOW.CF_DIRECTION = 'INFLOW' AND CON_FLOW.CF_ITEM =1) UNION ( SELECT CON.CONTRACT_ID, CON.CONTRACT_NAME, CON.CONTRACT_NUMBER, CON.APPROVAL_NUMBER, CON_FLOW.DUE_AMOUNT, CON_FLOW.RECEIVED_AMOUNT, CON_FLOW. TIMES, 'FCT_CONTRACT' DOC_CATEGORY FROM FCT_CONTRACT CON JOIN FCT_QUOTATION_CASHFLOW CON_FLOW ON CON.CONTRACT_ID = CON_FLOW.CONTRACT_ID WHERE CON.DATA_CLASS = 'NORMAL' AND CON_FLOW.CF_STATUS = 'RELEASE' AND CON_FLOW.CF_DIRECTION = 'INFLOW' AND CON_FLOW.CF_ITEM IN(54,55) ) ) CONTRACT ON CLCP.PLEDGE_DOC_ID = CONTRACT.CONTRACT_ID AND CLCP.PLEDGE_DOC_CATEGORY = CONTRACT.DOC_CATEGORY WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY CLCP.PLEDGE_ID, CONTRACT.CONTRACT_NAME, CONTRACT.CONTRACT_NUMBER, CONTRACT.APPROVAL_NUMBER, CONTRACT.CONTRACT_ID ) CON ON CLCP.PLEDGE_ID = CON.PLEDGE_ID WHERE 1 = 1
AND CLCP.CONTRACT_ID =#{contractId}

SELECT sum( ccc.due_amount ) amount FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc WHERE ccc.cf_item in (1 ,3) and ccc.CF_DIRECTION ='INFLOW' AND ccc.write_off_flag = 'NOT' and ccc.contract_id=#{contractId} and to_char(ccc.due_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') <= to_char(#{pledgeTimesTo},'YYYY-MM-DD') and to_char(ccc.due_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') >= to_char(#{pledgeTimesFrom},'YYYY-MM-DD')

SELECT CONTRACT.CONTRACT_ID PLEDGE_DOC_ID, CONTRACT.CONTRACT_NAME PLEDGE_DOC_NAME, CONTRACT.APPROVAL_NUMBER PLEDGE_DOC_NUMBER, CONTRACT.DOC_CATEGORY PLEDGE_DOC_CATEGORY, SUM(CONTRACT.DUE_AMOUNT) DUE_AMOUNT, nvl(SUM(CONTRACT.DUE_AMOUNT),0) -nvl(SUM(CONTRACT.RECEIVED_AMOUNT),0) SURPLUS_AMOUNT FROM ( ( SELECT CON.CONTRACT_ID, CON.CONTRACT_NAME, CON.CONTRACT_NUMBER, PP.APPROVAL_NUMBER, CON.COMPANY_ID, CON_FLOW.DUE_AMOUNT, CON_FLOW.RECEIVED_AMOUNT, CON_FLOW.TIMES, CON_FLOW.WRITE_OFF_FLAG, 'CON_CONTRACT' DOC_CATEGORY FROM CON_CONTRACT CON JOIN PRJ_PROJECT PP ON PP.PROJECT_ID=CON.PROJECT_ID JOIN CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW CON_FLOW ON CON.CONTRACT_ID=CON_FLOW.CONTRACT_ID WHERE CON.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' AND (CON.CONTRACT_STATUS = 'INCEPT' OR (CON.CONTRACT_STATUS='PENDING' AND ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CON_CONTRACT FT WHERE FT.DATA_CLASS='CHANGE_REQ' AND FT.CONTRACT_STATUS='INCEPT' AND FT.REF_CONTRACT_ID=CON.CONTRACT_ID ) >0)) AND CON_FLOW.CF_STATUS='RELEASE' AND CON_FLOW.CF_DIRECTION='INFLOW'
AND (CON.PLEDGE_FLAG='N' OR CON.PLEDGE_FLAG IS NULL)
AND CON_FLOW.CF_ITEM =1 ) UNION ( SELECT CON.CONTRACT_ID, CON.CONTRACT_NAME, CON.CONTRACT_NUMBER, CON.APPROVAL_NUMBER, CON.COMPANY_ID, CON_FLOW.DUE_AMOUNT, CON_FLOW.RECEIVED_AMOUNT, CON_FLOW.TIMES, CON_FLOW.WRITE_OFF_FLAG, 'FCT_CONTRACT' DOC_CATEGORY FROM FCT_CONTRACT CON JOIN FCT_QUOTATION_CASHFLOW CON_FLOW ON CON.CONTRACT_ID=CON_FLOW.CONTRACT_ID WHERE CON.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' AND (CON.CONTRACT_STATUS = 'INCEPT' OR (CON.CONTRACT_STATUS='PENDING' AND ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM FCT_CONTRACT FT WHERE FT.DATA_CLASS='CHANGE_REQ' AND FT.CONTRACT_STATUS='INCEPT' AND FT.REF_CONTRACT_ID=CON.CONTRACT_ID ) >0)) AND CON_FLOW.CF_STATUS='RELEASE' AND CON_FLOW.CF_DIRECTION='INFLOW'
AND (CON.PLEDGE_FLAG='N' OR CON.PLEDGE_FLAG IS NULL)
AND CON_FLOW.CF_ITEM IN(54,55) ) ) CONTRACT WHERE 1=1 AND CONTRACT.COMPANY_ID=#{companyId}
AND CONTRACT.CONTRACT_ID=#{pledgeDocId}
AND CONTRACT.DOC_CATEGORY=#{pledgeDocCategory}
AND #{pledgeTimesFrom}<=CONTRACT.TIMES
AND #{pledgeTimesTo} >=CONTRACT.TIMES
AND CONTRACT.APPROVAL_NUMBER LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{pledgeDocNumber}),'%')
AND CONTRACT.CONTRACT_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{pledgeDocName}),'%')
GROUP BY CONTRACT.CONTRACT_NAME, CONTRACT.CONTRACT_NUMBER, CONTRACT.APPROVAL_NUMBER, CONTRACT.CONTRACT_ID, CONTRACT.DOC_CATEGORY
mapper.update: UPDATE FCT_CONTRACT CON SET CON.PLEDGE_FLAG='N' WHERE CON.PLEDGE_FLAG='Y' AND CON.CONTRACT_ID IN ( SELECT LCP.PLEDGE_DOC_ID FROM LON_CONTRACT LC JOIN CT_LON_CONTRACT_PLEDGE LCP ON LC.CONTRACT_ID=LCP.CONTRACT_ID WHERE LCP.PLEDGE_DOC_CATEGORY='FCT_CONTRACT' AND LCP.PLEDGE_RELEASE_FLAG='Y' AND LC.SETTLE_STATUS='CLEARED' )

UPDATE CON_CONTRACT CON SET CON.PLEDGE_FLAG='N' WHERE CON.PLEDGE_FLAG='Y' AND CON.CONTRACT_ID IN ( SELECT LCP.PLEDGE_DOC_ID FROM LON_CONTRACT LC JOIN CT_LON_CONTRACT_PLEDGE LCP ON LC.CONTRACT_ID=LCP.CONTRACT_ID WHERE LCP.PLEDGE_DOC_CATEGORY='CON_CONTRACT' AND LCP.PLEDGE_RELEASE_FLAG='Y' AND LC.SETTLE_STATUS='CLEARED' )

UPDATE CT_LON_CONTRACT_PLEDGE LCP SET LCP.PLEDGE_RELEASE_FLAG='N' WHERE LCP.PLEDGE_RELEASE_FLAG='Y' AND LCP.CONTRACT_ID IN ( SELECT LC.CONTRACT_ID FROM LON_CONTRACT LC WHERE LC.CONTRACT_ID=LCP.CONTRACT_ID AND LC.SETTLE_STATUS='CLEARED')
